A '''family''' of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] arrived on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and were able to gain recognition and influence after proving ancestral links to [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblood Sith]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Noble Legacy}}</ref>
